appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Product Rating Share by Category'.
Six blue circular markers are plotted horizontally across categories: Quality, Price, Design, Support, Delivery, Other.
The Price point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 27 on the y-axis, with a text label '49%' directly above it.
The Support point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 47 on the y-axis, with a text label '33%' directly above it.
The Other point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 45 on the y-axis, with a text label '34%' directly above it.
The Delivery point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 44 on the y-axis, with a text label '29%' directly above it.
The Design point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 22 on the y-axis, with a text label '30%' directly above it.
The Quality point is positioned at a vertical level of approximately 13 on the y-axis, with a text label '14%' directly above it.

printed_facts.fact: Vertical axis is labeled 'Value' with tick marks ranging from 0 to 50 in increments of 5.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Category' with tick labels: Quality, Price, Design, Support, Delivery, Other.
Labeled percentage values for each category are: Quality 14%, Price 49%, Design 30%, Support 33%, Delivery 29%, Other 34%.
